0.original: Simmie would entrust you with a delivery.

1.original: With your aid, Simmie has completed her report on the ghostly horseman sighted in the Shroud─now identified as the primal Odin. Return to the Waking Sands and deliver a copy of the report to Urianger.

2.original: After perusing the report, Urianger shares with you his misgivings about the historical accuracy of the scriptures. Casting light upon the events of ages past is a tall task, indeed.

24.original: Deliver the Odin report to Urianger.

48.original: Your assistance in the investigation has proven invaluable, adventurer. You have our thanks.

49.original: With your aid, I have finally managed to complete my report─a thorough survey of all eyewitness reports, along with the most credible theories regarding the Dark Divinity's presence in the Shroud.

50.original: I intend to deliver copies of the report to Brother O<hex:021F0103>App<hex:021F0103>Pesi and Bowlord Lewin myself.

51.original: The Scions, too, will no doubt be eager to learn of our findings. I would be most appreciative if you could deliver a copy to Urianger in my stead.

52.original: My duties demand that I remain composed, but in all truth, I fear for the fate of our people. Should the time come that the Dark Divinity draws his blade against Gridania, promise me that we can count on your aid.

53.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I am most heartened by thy safe return. Wert thou able to cast light on the shadows that haunt the Shroud?

54.original: ...So it is true. Having awakened from nigh-eternal slumber, the Dark Divinity now rides free in the Shroud.

55.original: Whilst you were afield, I immersed myself in the scriptures. The more I scoured the words, the more I did realize that the writings draw heavily upon Allagan historical chronicles.

56.original: History is quite a fascinating beast, is it not? One nation's glory is another's suffering─one nation's great hero, another's most abhorrent villain.

57.original: I mean not to speak in platitudes, only to say that there is never but a single side to any story─even a story that is presented as historical fact.

58.original: To what end did the great hero of Allag seal Odin in a gaol of crystal? What impels the Dark Divinity to ride once again? Cast thy light on the shadows of history, friend, that we might be delivered from the darkness.
